tags.name: Callback
tags.description: The merchant's system has to implement this endpoint to receive callback requests.

parameters.name: X-RequestDate
parameters.description: Current timestamp formatted according to RFC 7231, section 7.1.1.2; part of the signature input.

parameters.name: X-RandomValue
parameters.description: A random value; part of the signature input.

parameters.name: Digest
parameters.description: SHA-256 hash of the message body

parameters.name: Signature
parameters.description:
HMAC-256 signature. The values of the "Digest", "X-RequestDate" and "X-RandomValue" headers 
 are concatenated. The signature is calculated using the `client_key` as the secret.

200.description: Acknowledges the receipt of the callback.

AliasInfo.description: Contains information about the created or updated alias. This field is null if the there was no 'alias_info' in the request.

amount.description: Minor currency value of an amount of money.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, three uppercase letters.

bic.description:
The business identifier code (BIC) of a bank account. If the branch identifier
                (positions 9 to 11) is not applicable, it is set to "XXX".

iban.description: The international bank account number of a bank account.

account_holder.description: The account holder of the bank account.

rc.description: Response code of the transaction. "0" in the case of a successful transaction. Other values signify errors.

message.description: Success or error message, text for the response code.

event_id.description: A unique ID for the event.

tx_id.description: Unique transaction identifier. Can be used to reference this transaction.

back_rc.description: Response code of a backend system, for example the GICC response code.

client_id.description: The client ID used to calculate the signature.

basket_id.description: The shopping basket number as submitted in the initial request.

additional_data.description: As submitted in the initial request.

accounts.description: Account details after a PSD2 account info request.

address_line_2.description: An address line. For 3DS this maps to additional1.

address_line_3.description: An address line. For 3DS this maps to additional2.

state.description: State or province of the address.

country.description: The ISO 3166 Alpha-2 country code (upper case) of the individual's homeland.

CommonAddress.description: Address data as applicable to most use cases.

number.description: The credit card number (Primary Account Number). It is sometimes masked in response messages, for example 411111******1111.

cardholder.description: The holder of a credit card.

issuer_country.description: The card issuers country of origin.  The use of this field requires an explicit activation. Please contact customer support.

mandate_id.description: Unique identification of the SEPA mandate. Use it for managed and already created mandates.

signed_on.description: Date when the SEPA mandate was issued. Full-date notation as defined by RFC 3339, section 5.6.

iban.description: The international bank account number of a bank account.

bban.description: Used for payment accounts which have no IBAN.

pan.description:
Primary Account Number (PAN) of a card, can be tokenized by the ASPSP due to PCI DSS
requirements.

masked_pan.description: Primary Account Number (PAN) of a card in a masked form.

msisdn.description: An alias to access a payment account via a registered mobile phone number.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, three uppercase letters.

iban.description: The international bank account number of a bank account.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, three uppercase letters.

name.description: Name of the account given by the bank or the PSU in online-banking.

product.description: Product name of the bank for this account, proprietary definition.

status.description:
Status of the account

* `ENABLED`: account is available
* `DELETED`: account is terminated
* `BLOCKED`: account is blocked for example for legal reasons

usage.description:
Specifies the usage of the account

* `PRIV`: private personal account
* `ORGA`: professional account
* `TEST_USAGE`: returned by Sparkassen sandbox

details.description:
Specifications that might be provided by the ASPSP such as characteristics of the account or
characteristics of the relevant card.

balances.description: Balance(s) of the account. There might be more than one balance with different types.

PSD2AccountDetails.description: Contains details of a customer's bank account.

type.description:
The following balance types are excluding credit limits unless the `credit_limit_included` element
is present and equals true in the corresponding balance element.
This definition is following ISO20022 logic for defining balance types.

* `CLOSING_BOOKED`: Balance of the account at the end of the pre-agreed account reporting
period. It is the sum of the opening booked balance at the beginning of
the period and all entries booked to the account during the pre-agreed
account reporting period. For card-accounts, this is composed of invoiced, but not yet paid entries
* `EXPECTED`: Balance composed of booked entries and pending items known at the
time of calculation, which projects the end of day balance if everything
is booked on the account and no other entry is posted.
For card accounts, this is composed of invoiced, but not yet paid entries,
not yet invoiced but already booked entries and pending items (not yet booked),
* `OPENING_BOOKED`: Book balance of the account at the beginning of the account reporting
period. It always equals the closing book balance from the previous
report.
* `INTERIM_AVAILABLE`: Available balance calculated in the course of the account servicer’s
business day, at the time specified, and subject to further changes during the business day. The interim balance is calculated on the basis
of booked credit and debit items during the calculation time/period
specified.
For card-accounts, this is composed of invoiced, but not yet paid entries and not yet invoiced but already booked entries
* `INTERIM_BOOKED`: Balance calculated in the course of the account servicer's business day,
at the time specified, and subject to further changes during the business
day. The interim balance is calculated on the basis of booked credit and
debit items during the calculation time/period specified.
* `FORWARD_AVAILABLE`: Forward available balance of money that is at the disposal of the
account owner on the date specified.
* `NON_INVOICED`: Only for card accounts, to be defined yet.
* `PREVIOUSLY_CLOSED`: Balance of the account at the previously closed account reporting period.

credit_limit_included.description:
A flag indicating if the credit limit of the corresponding account is included in
                    the calculation of the balance, where applicable.

last_change.description:
This data element might be used to indicate for example with the expected or
booked balance that no action is known on the account, which is not yet booked.
Date-time notation as defined by RFC 3339, section 5.6.

reference_date.description: Indicates the date of the balance. Full-date notation as defined by RFC 3339, section 5.6.

source_currency.description: Currency from which an amount is to be converted in a currency conversion.

exchange_rate.description:
Factor used to convert an amount from one currency into another. This reflects the
price at which one currency was bought with another currency.

unit_currency.description:
Currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange. In the
example 1 EUR = xxx CUR, the unit currency is EUR.

target_currency.description: Currency into which an amount is to be converted in a currency conversion.

quotation_date.description: Date at which an exchange rate is quoted.

contract_identification.description: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the foreign exchange contract.

mandate_id.description: Identification of mandates, for example, a SEPA mandate ID.

creditor_id.description: Identification of creditors, for example, a SEPA Creditor ID.

booking_date.description: The date when an entry is posted to an account on the ASPSPs books.

value_date.description:
Date at which assets become available to the account owner in case
of a credit entry, or cease to be available to the account owner in case of a debit entry.
Usage: If entry status is pending and value date is present, then the value date refers to an expected/requested
value date.

creditor_name.description: Name of the creditor of a "debited" transaction.

ultimate_creditor.description: Name of the ultimate creditor of a "debited" transaction.

debtor_name.description: Name of the debtor of a "credited" transaction.

ultimate_debtor.description: Name of the ultimate debtor of a "credited" transaction.

entry_reference.description: Entry reference, for example from camt.052 message.

additional_information.description:
Might be used by the ASPSP to transport additional transaction related
    information to the PSU.

bank_transaction_code.description:
Bank transaction code as used by the ASPSP and using the sub-elements of
this structured code defined by ISO20022.

proprietary_bank_transaction_code.description:
Proprietary bank transaction code as used within a community or within an
ASPSP, for example for MT94x based transaction reports.

PSD2Transaction.description: A transaction of a bank account.

phone_number.description: A phone number in its canonical international E.164 numbering plan format.

PhoneContact.description: A means of contacting a customer by phone.

field.description: The name of the field which was the reason of the request rejection.

reason.description: The reason why the request was rejected.

RiskmanErrorFieldInformation.description: Field name and reason why the request was rejected.

error_field_information.description: Detailed field level information regarding the reason why the request was rejected.

error_message.description: The reason why the request was rejected.
error_message.example: Declined - The request is missing one or more fields.

error_reason.description: The reason why the request was rejected from the backend system.

error_status.description: The status why the request was rejected from the backend system.

RiskmanErrorInformation.description: Detailed error information including fields which had been the reasons for unsuccessful processing.

case_priority.description: Riskcheck information regarding the case priority.

event_id.description: A unique ID for the event.

Riskcheck information regarding the customer list risk check.  See user guide for details and all possible values.
Indicates the device behavior information code(s) returned from device fingerprinting. See user guide for details and all possible values.
Riskcheck information regarding the velocity risk check. See user guide for details and all possible values.
Riskcheck information regarding the identity change. See user guide for details and all possible values.
Riskcheck information regarding the internet check. See user guide for details and all possible values.
Riskcheck information regarding the phone risk check. See user guide for details and all possible values.
Riskcheck information regarding suspicious risk. See user guide for details and all possible values.

List of information codes triggered by the order. These information codes were generated when you created
the order and product velocity rules and are returned so that you can associate them with the rules. See user guide for details and all possible values.

localtime.description: Riskcheck information regarding the local time of the risk check.

profile_destination_queue.description: Riskcheck information regarding the profile destination queue of the risk check.

profile_name.description: Riskcheck information regarding the profile of the risk check.

profile_selectorrule.description: Riskcheck information regarding the profile selector rule risk check.

items.description: Providers used to calculate the risk.
Riskcheck information regarding the matched rules in risk check.

score.description: Calculated risk score of request data.

items.description: Riskcheck information regarding the profile factor codes of the risk check. See user guide for all possible values.

score_model_used.description: Name of the score model used for the transaction. This field contains the name of risk management’s selected model.

travel_actual_final_dst_country.description: Actual country of final destination of the travel.

travel_actual_final_dst_locality.description: Actual city of final destination of the travel.

travel_first_departure_country.description: First departure country of the travel.

travel_first_departure_locality.description: First departure city of the travel.

tx_risk_status.description: Status result of an external risk management transaction. See user guide for all possible values.

tx_scoring_id.description: Unique scoring transaction identifier. Can be used to reference the depending scoring transaction.

utc_time.description: Riskcheck information regarding the UTC time of the risk check, used in error cases.

tds_auth_level.description:
The 3D-Secure transaction status.
        
* `FULL`: Full 3-D Secure Authentification
* `ATTEMPT`: 3-D Secure Authentification attempted

tds_ares_trans_status_reason.description: 3-D Secure 2: reason for the ARes transaction status.

tds_rreq_trans_status_reason.description: 3-D Secure 2: reason for the RReq transaction status.

TDSInfo.description: Contains 3-D Secure response data.  The use of this field requires an explicit activation. Please contact customer support.

recurring_payment.description: Identifier of a recurring credit card payment.

cvc_result.description:
Response code of the verification of the card verification code
         according to the response of a backend system.  This value is available on some backend systems.  The use of this field requires an explicit activation. Please contact customer support.  
         Possible values:
        
* `CVC_MATCH`
* `CVC_NO_MATCH`
* `CVC_NO_RESPONSE_RECEIVED`
* `CVC_NOT_PROCESSED`
* `CVC_NOT_PROVIDED`
* `CVC_SHOULD_BE_ON_CARD`
* `CVC_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE`

avs_result.description:
Response code of the address verification according to the response of a backend system. 
         This value is available on some backend systems.  The use of this field requires an explicit activation. Please contact customer support.  Possible values:
        
* `MATCH`
* `NO_MATCH`

back_state.description:
State of a transaction according to the response of a backend system. 
         This value is available on some backend systems.  The use of this field requires an explicit activation. Please contact customer support.  Possible values:
        
* `DECLINED`
* `AUTHORIZED`
* `REVERSED`
* `CAPTURED`
* `SETTLED`

ip_address.description: The customer's IP address associated with this transaction.  The use of this field requires an explicit activation. Please contact customer support.
